name: Hodan
face: Young Djiboutian girl with warm medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, a small nose, and a bright open smile.
clothing: Coral dirac with short puffed sleeves and gold floral embroidery, a gold belt with a round red gem, and a peach-gold headscarf with a gold border and gold fringe. Gold hoop earrings, a gold bead necklace, gold bangles on both wrists, and brown sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Shoulder-length dark wavy hair under a peach-gold fringed headscarf, gold hoops, bead necklace and bangles, and a gold belt with a red gem over the coral floral dirac.
